status: actor-visible paper acceptance consolidation; no policy implementation, native game, competitive qualification, or win-rate claim

crossFamilyPolicyInvariants: Bench width must be scored as an opponent resource, not only candidate setup: Electro Rain Prize packets, Full Moon Rondo damage, Koffing counter production and Snorlax trap surface all increase with unnecessary bodies.
Horror House denies cards played from hand, not attacks, retreat, already-in-play Stadium effects, or in-play Abilities.
Path to the Peak has matchup-specific jobs and can be dominated by its self-suppression cost unless New Moon is actually active.
Native/direct attackers must remain available when Basic Ability suppression turns off Perfection.
Resolved effects are not rewound: post-Bomb Path does not remove attached Energy; post-Altered-Creation New Moon has no Ranger reset in the fixed 60.
Discrete HP/Prize breakpoints override average-damage heuristics.

Ability suppression is scoped, not binary: recompute Basic/Rule-Box/Active/global suppression before and after Stadium replacement; Iron Thorns leaves Lunatone live, while Klefki/Silent Lab/Empoleon can disable the New Moon shield.

Prize state is a transition variable, not a score: settle simultaneous self-KO/effect-KO Prize events before recomputing Ace Trainer, Reversal/Counter Energy, Ursaluna discounts and Altered-Creation Prize modifiers.

A lock deletes only its actual action class: Ability suppression, Basic attack suppression, Item lock, Supporter lock and hand-play lock require different fallback sets; recompute native printed attacks before declaring lockout.

Lock-resilient search is multi-channel: TPE Energy, Forest Seal Stone Tool/VSTAR search, Powerglass Basic-Energy recursion and Stadium replacement survive different card-type locks; track Tool and Basic-Energy custody explicitly.
Before passing into Bench-punishment, compress/harden existing liabilities: Farewell unneeded Unown when legal and evolve Duskull when the HP/Stage change alters opponent reply thresholds.

Attack effects persist only while their target remains in the relevant state: explicitly score retreat/switch/evolution before treating copied Techno Blast, Eon Blade or Pale Moon as future-turn guarantees.
At K1, exact Prize knowledge must recompute continuation viability and DCI; do not preserve singleton/pair pieces for lines whose prerequisite is Prized or discard the only surviving redundancy.

required: Pass every inherited and added actor-visible case or produce an explicit, reviewable alternative continuation for any case the policy intentionally rejects.
Expose selected continuation, strongest immediate opponent reply, Prize delta, Bench delta, and any card protected from discard/search cost.
TPE target selection must permit 0, 1, or 2 legal targets.
Attack-copy, self-KO, Stadium replacement, Active/Bench Ability scope, and hand-lock semantics must be represented from actor-visible state.
No hidden opponent hand identities, face-down Prize identities, or future draws may be used.
implementationGate.stopCondition: Failure on a family gate is evidence against policy readiness and can trigger architecture reconsideration before native/full-game compute; it is not permission to silently add cards to the fixed 60.
